check: no NaN / inf in joints, frame features, tempo
joint positions within 2.5 leg lengths of the hip
joint speed (99th percentile of the per-rep maximum)
knees below the hip at the rep start
toes in front of the heels (forward axis)
left hip on the left side (lateral axis)
rep starts moving (knee flexion rises within the first 15 %)
rep ends moving (knee flexion falls within the last 15 %)
bottom of the squat inside the rep (10-90 %)
squat depth (max - min knee flexion) at least 30 deg
heel_lift: highest heel above the toe
